column1: # Driven by `just test-dynlink-x86`, which builds the loader and the two C artifacts and
# injects all three into the image (`DYNLINK_BINS`).
# One step per line, as `tools/smoke/scenario.tsv` documents: the command, a tab, and the
# whole line its output must produce. `/bin/dynhello` is a classic-dynamic `ET_EXEC`: it
# carries `PT_INTERP /libexec/ld.so` and `DT_NEEDED libdyn.so`, and its single PLT call
# (`dyn_message`) is bound by the loader before `main` runs. The string it prints exists
# only in `/lib/libdyn.so` — the gate fails if the same bytes are in the program — so this
# line is the loader having run, mapped the object and patched the GOT.
